data.reason: Nothing has been produced. The ladder requires technical_spec, dev_plan, capability and implementation. The spec and the capability contract can both be written directly from the intent, so they come first.
data.wave_reason: technical_spec and capability each need only the INTENT, so two agents can write them at the same time without seeing each other's work. dev_plan needs the spec's parts and flows to sequence the work, so it waits for wave 2. implementation needs the spec and the contract, so it waits for wave 3. stories are only recommended and are not needed at prototype rigor.

gap.statement: There is no technical design and no durable capability contract for levels. Without them there is nothing to plan or implement against: the refill, reset and level-increment behaviour, the level shown next to the score, and the rule that score and lives are kept are all undefined.

premises.text: The INTENT asks for a level-up flow: when all dots are eaten, refill the maze, reset pacman and the ghosts, increment the level, keep score and lives, and show the level next to the score.
The ladder lists technical_spec and capability as required and missing, and nothing has been produced yet.

artifacts.task: Describe how levels are built into the existing game, brownfield. Cover the level state, the point where the win is detected, the reset of maze, pacman and ghosts, preservation of score and lives, the level display next to the score, and how it is tested.

Write the canon capability for level progression. State what it is for and give testable criteria: clearing all dots refills the maze; pacman and the ghosts return to their start places; the level goes up by 1; score and lives are kept; the level is shown next to the score.

rejected.why: It needs the technical spec's parts and flows to sequence the work, so it cannot be written at the same time as the spec.
It needs the spec and the contract first. Code written now would be guesswork at the design.
The ladder still requires artifacts the catalogue can produce.
